events.description: Completed the acquisition of the Andrew Business from CommScope on January 31, 2025, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $2,033.5 million net of cash acquired.
events.source_quote: On January 31, 2025, pursuant to a purchase agreement (the “CommScope Purchase Agreement”) with CommScope, dated July 18, 2024, the Company completed the acquisition of the Andrew Business from CommScope for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $2,033.5 net of cash acquired and subject to customary post-closing adjustments.

events.description: Completed two acquisitions during the first quarter of 2025 (the 2025 Acquisitions) for a total of approximately $2,172.2 million net of cash acquired, including the Andrew Business.
events.source_quote: During the three months ended March 31, 2025, the Company completed two acquisitions (collectively, the “2025 Acquisitions”), including the acquisition of the Andrew Business from CommScope, for approximately $2,172.2, net of cash acquired.

events.description: Completed two acquisitions during 2024 (the 2024 Acquisitions), including the acquisition of CIT, for approximately $2,156.4 million, net of cash acquired.
events.source_quote: During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company completed two acquisitions (collectively, the “2024 Acquisitions”), including the acquisition of CIT, for approximately $2,156.4, net of cash acquired.

events.description: Repurchased 2.7 million shares of Class A Common Stock for $180.9 million under the Board-authorized $2.0 billion stock repurchase program during the first quarter of 2025.
events.source_quote: On April 23, 2024, the Board authorized a stock repurchase program under which the Company may purchase up to $2,000.0 of its Common Stock during the three-year period ending on the close of business on April 28, 2027 (the “2024 Stock Repurchase Program”). ... During the three months ended March 31, 2025, the Company repurchased 2.7 million shares of its Common Stock for $180.9 under the 2024 Stock Repurchase Program.
